sealed_statement.proper_mask_reachability: For any induced P7-free dynamic boundary subgraph G[D] and any proper color mask F subsetneq [4], exact-use mask reachability rho_D(F) is constructively polynomial via at most O(|D|^3) calls to the known P7-free List-3 algorithm, by forcing one witness vertex per color of F. No List-4 call is needed.
sealed_statement.full_mask: For every nonempty component C, mu_C([4])=0. Single-color union differences in a monotone message always have the form alpha notin F and 1 -> 0. Therefore [4] never needs reachability resolution for the declared B-C/C-X0 transition tests.
sealed_statement.B_C: For every two-sided source-consistent B-C transition with nonempty common baseline D^-, Delta_BC={(F,alpha):rho_{D^-}(F)=1, alpha in A(b), mu(F)!=mu(F union {alpha})} is an exact iff test for equality of the local component-boundary feasibility relation. Delta empty means PROVED_NEUTRAL locally; Delta nonempty gives an explicit local distinguishing coloring and PROVED_NONNEUTRAL locally.
sealed_statement.B_C_empty_baseline_guard: If D^-=empty, the anticomplete state would violate sealed all-components-coupled source law, so it is not a two-sided source-consistent transition. mu(empty) is not queried.
sealed_statement.C_X0: For a C-X0 base-list transition, recompile the before/after component messages with C0 and compare them only on proper masks reachable by rho_{D_C}. Equality on all reachable proper masks is necessary and sufficient for equality of the local component-boundary feasibility relation; full mask is automatically bad in both states.
sealed_statement.component_transition_signature: After polynomial compilation, declared B-C and C-X0 local transition semantics factor through constant-size rho/message/delta signatures. Reconstruction retains a pointer to the actual source component state and its C0 witness table.

lifecycle.per_rho: O(|D|^3*T_L3(|D|)) up to constant mask factors
lifecycle.component_recompilation: At most 15 List-3 calls per base-system state plus rho compilation; polynomial over all O(n^2) candidate local transitions.
